description: This file defines models, interfaces, enums, constants, and utility functions related to mobile applications within the Thingsboard platform, including mobile app details, QR code settings, menu configurations, and localization mappings.

methods.name: getDefaultMobileMenuItem
methods.description: Returns a deep clone of the default mobile menu items with visibility set based on hideDefaultMenuItems.

methods.name: isDefaultMobileMenuItem
methods.description: Type guard to check if a MobilePage is a DefaultMobilePage based on its id.

methods.name: mobilePageEqualToDefault
methods.description: Compares a MobilePage to a DefaultMobilePage to determine if they are equivalent based on id, label, and icon.

methods.name: isDefaultMobilePagesConfig
methods.description: Checks if a list of MobilePage items matches the default mobile menu configuration.
